battle.name: 宋元戰爭
battle.brief: 端平元年（1234）宋師北伐收三京不成，蒙古自端平二年起全面南侵，戰火由四川、荊襄延至江淮與廣南海面，至祥興二年（1279）崖山收官。卡面的希臘火在此戰線上對應宋廷名籍中的猛火油，屬火攻器材，與砲石、火藥同列，專司焚燒攻城器械與敵舟帆篷；其配製早已失傳，實戰規模無從核實。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 南宋與蒙古（元）兩個政權在十二世紀中葉到十三世紀末的四十餘年裡全面對撞。南宋自1127年南渡後定都臨安，疆域只剩兩淮、荊湖、四川與廣南；樞密院掌兵權，禁軍為京師宿衛主力，廂軍與鄉兵填補州縣，長江上游設四川制置司，荊湖、江淮、兩浙分置安撫司與制置司，築城守口、屯田儲糧。理宗端平初年聯蒙古滅金，北伐失利後改守疆域，仍在四川推行余玠的山城防禦。蒙古原為草原帝國，行十戶、百戶、千戶、萬戶的軍戶與怯薛宿衛體制，攻宋前已收編漢人軍隊，並築漢中、興元兩處基地，由荊襄、蜀口、江淮、海路四面向南同時施壓。1271年忽必烈建號大元、定都大都後，南征改由伯顏、阿朮等統一調度，江淮糧賦與泉州海船成為持久戰爭的兩根支柱。
countriesEn: Southern Song and the Mongols, later the Yuan, collided head-on across the better part of four decades, from the middle of the twelfth century to the end of the thirteenth. After the move south in 1127 the Song fixed its capital at Lin'an, its territory reduced to the Two Huai, Jinghu, Sichuan and the far south: the Privy Council held military power, the Palace Guard formed the capital's standing army, and provincial troops and local militia filled out the prefectures, with the Sichuan Circuit in the upper Yangtze and separate pacification and circuit offices in Jinghu, Jianghuai and Zhejiang building passes, storing grain and farming garrisons. Under Lizong the Song first joined the Mongols to destroy Jin; after the northern campaign of the Duanping era failed it settled down to defence, yet still pursued Yu Jie's mountain-fortress system in Sichuan. The Mongols began as a steppe empire, organizing households into units of ten, a hundred, a thousand and ten thousand with a keshig guard; before turning on the Song they had already absorbed Chinese-trained armies and built the two bases of Hanzhong and Xingyuan, pressing south at the same time from Jingxiang, the Sichuan mouth, Jianghuai and the sea. After Kublai Khan proclaimed the state of Da Yuan in 1271 and fixed the capital at Dadu, the southern war was run as a single operation by Bayan, Aju and their colleagues, with the taxes and grain of Jianghuai and the ocean-going ships of Quanzhou as its two long-term pillars.
people: 宋方決策以理宗趙昀為首，他同意端平入洛北伐，咸淳年間換相，讓權相賈似道主持朝政。賈似道以「國守家養」四字定策：向蒙古輸納歲幣，以銀錢折算，以收贖買回被佔土地，同時把江淮、荊湖、兩浙的精銳重編為御前軍，分層統制，節制諸將。襄樊方面，呂文德坐鎮襄陽，張貴、張禧率民兵赴援，張貴兵敗被殺，其弟張順率死士溯江破元軍鐵索，抵城下時溺死。四川由余玠經營山城，江陵由孟珙收復荊襄，真州由李庭芝死守，潭州李芾、鄂州高達各閉城固守。崖山時張世杰總水軍，陸秀夫負少帝趙昺投海；文天祥1278年兵敗被俘，過零丁洋，1283年遇害。元方有蒙哥大汗，1259年攻釣魚城時死於軍中；忽必烈1260年於開平即位，與阿里不哥爭汗位至1264年，阿朮、伯顏先後主持南征，劉秉忠謀定都城與建國，漢軍將領董文炳、史天澤、張柔出力，耶律楚材力主勸農安民。襄陽之失常被歸咎降元的劉整與范文虎，然而六年圍城與回回砲的攻勢才是真正的關鍵。
peopleEn: On the Song side policy was led by Emperor Lizong Zhao Yun, who authorised the Duanping northern campaign and changed chancellors in the Xianchun years, leaving the government to the powerful chancellor Jia Sidao. Jia framed his policy in four characters, 'the state defends, the household sustains': pay the Mongols their tribute in silver, convert it into cash, and buy back occupied land, while at the same time reorganising the picked troops of Jianghuai, Jinghu and Zhejiang into a new imperial army under layered command to restrain the generals. Over Xiangyang and Fancheng, Lü Wende held the city while Zhang Gui and Zhang Xi led the militia to its relief; Zhang Gui was killed after the defeat, and his brother Zhang Shun broke the Mongol cordon over the river with a band of forlorn troops, only to drown at the foot of the wall. Yu Jie built the mountain-fortress network in Sichuan, Meng Gong recovered Jingzhou from Jiangling, Li Tingzhi held Zhenzhou to the last, while Li Fu at Tanzhou and Gao Da at Ezhou each shut himself up in his own city. At Yamen Zhang Shijie commanded the fleet and Lu Xiufu carried the child emperor Zhao Bing into the sea. Wen Tianxiang was captured in 1278 after his army was broken, passed through Lingding Ocean, and was executed in 1283. On the Mongol side there was the Great Khan Möngke, who died in camp during the siege of Fishing Town in 1259; Kublai was crowned at Kaiping in 1260 and disputed the khanship with Ariq Böke until 1264; Aju and then Bayan directed the campaigns; Liu Bingzhong worked out the capital and the shape of the state; the Chinese-trained generals Dong Wenbing, Shi Tianze and Zhang Rou all contributed, and Yelü Chucai pressed for farming and the welfare of the people. The fall of Xiangyang was often blamed on the defectors Liu Zheng and Fan Wenhu, though the six-year siege and the counterweight trebuchet were the real turning points.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是拜占庭式的希臘火：低溫燃燒劑灌在銅管內點燃，用以在水面黏著燃燒，燒穿帆布與船板，配方的祕密隨沉船而失。它在這場戰爭裡的對應物是宋廷名籍上的猛火油，又稱火油。唐以來即有記載，十國春秋記917年吳越王錢鏐送猛火油助吳，吳越備史並稱其遇水不滅；北宋《武經總要》已把猛火油列入火攻器械，與火藥、砲石並列。沈括《夢溪筆談》記鄜延出石油，可見猛火油與本土石油同源，並非拜占庭配方東來。十三世紀的宋元戰爭中，猛火油仍列在守城與水戰的火攻名目內，專職對付雲梯、木構攻城器與敵舟帆篷；其確切配製與使用方法已無記載可考，實戰用量亦無從核實。戰場上真正大宗消耗的是回回砲所發的石彈、震天雷一類火藥器、床弩與火箭，以及蒙古人自帶的馬匹與可拆卸的帳幕車帳。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Byzantine Greek fire: a low-temperature burning liquid poured into a copper tube and ignited, so that it clings to surfaces and burns through canvas and planking, its formula a state secret lost with the ships that carried it. Its counterpart in this war is the menghuoyou, the 'fierce fire oil' of the Song registers, also called fire oil. It has been recorded in China since the Tang: the Chunqiu of the Ten Kingdoms has it that in 917 the King of Wuyue, Qian Liu, sent fierce fire oil to aid Wu, and the Wuyue Beishi adds that it could not be put out by water; the Northern Song's Wujing Zongyao already listed fierce fire oil among the fire attack devices, alongside gunpowder and stone shot. Shen Kuo's Mengxi Bitan records petroleum in the Fu and Yan circuits, which shows that the Chinese oil grew out of local petroleum and was not a formula imported from Byzantium. Throughout the Song-Yuan war the menghuoyou still appeared in the fire attack inventory of both garrisons and fleets, its task being the siege ladders, the timber assault works and the canvas of enemy sails; the exact composition and the method of application are beyond recovery, and the quantity actually expended cannot be verified. What was consumed in bulk on the battlefield was stone shot fired by the Huihui pao, gunpowder devices such as the thunder-shaking bomb, heavy crossbows and fire arrows, together with the Mongols' own horses and their portable tents and baggage wagons.
tactics: 蒙古的攻法是典型的分路合擊加圍城打援：西路取漢中、興元後直趨蜀口，中路自河南南下襄漢，東路越兩淮，南路另以海船自泉州、廣州北上。對襄樊兩城，先以鹿角與鐵索橫斷漢水，使援軍不能靠岸，再集中回回砲火攻一面城樓，待崩出缺口後驅兵蟻附登城，城外騎兵同時切斷糧道。宋軍以守城為本，援軍多不肯再進，張順所率數百死士乘大舟硬闖元軍封江鐵索，破了封鎖仍救不了襄陽；守軍屢以夜襲出城焚燒攻城器械，火油、猛火油正用於此處。四川採余玠的山城體制，州縣治所移上山巔，蓄水屯田，蒙古騎兵失了衝鋒之地；江上水戰以連環船把船舷、桅杆、兵器用鐵索連成一體，前後不能自主退避，元軍則先以砲火與火箭攻擊，再用小舟抵近接舷登船，焦山、丁家洲兩役都見過火攻，伯顏在丁家洲還先放載薪柴的大筏佯作火攻，誘宋軍把注意力集中到江面，再以兩岸巨砲、床弩與突擊的騎兵、戰船一齊壓上。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method was the classic divided attack combined with besieging to intercept relief: the western route took Hanzhong and Xingyuan and then drove at the Sichuan mouth, the central route came down from Henan into Jingxiang, the eastern route crossed the Two Huai, and a southern route went by sea from Quanzhou and Guangzhou. Against the twin cities of Xiangyang and Fancheng they first set deer-horn barriers and iron chains across the Han River so that relief could not come ashore, then concentrated the fire of the Huihui pao against one sector of the walls until the towers came down, and only then drove the troops up the breach while cavalry outside cut the grain road. The Song fought from the walls: relief armies would not come on, and Zhang Shun's several hundred volunteers forced their way through the Mongol chain in great boats, breaking the cordon without saving the city; the garrison made night sallies to burn the assault works, and fire oil, the menghuoyou, was used for exactly that. Sichuan adopted Yu Jie's mountain system, moving the seats of prefectures to hilltops with stored water and tilled fields, so that Mongol cavalry lost the ground on which it charged. River warfare was fought with linked ships, hulls, masts and weapons bound together by iron chains so that no ship could withdraw alone, while the Mongols struck first with stone shot and fire arrows and then sent light craft alongside to board; fire attack appeared at both Jiaoshan and Dingjiazhou, and at Dingjiazhou Bayan even launched great rafts loaded with firewood as a feigned fire attack, drawing the Song's attention to the river surface, before the great trebuchets and heavy crossbows on the banks and a simultaneous push by cavalry and war boats closed in.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但仍有幾組可用的。襄樊自1267年被圍到1273年陷落，前後約六年；守軍包含數萬民兵，城中糧儲起初約可支一年，圍城後期僅餘數月，饑餓逼出殺牛馬佐食、以巴蕉皮煮食的記載，人相食之說亦見於史文，至於確數無從核實。回回砲由阿朮主持製造，約1271年造成，1272年後運抵襄陽，一砲所發石彈重數百斤，擊中城樓即崩，射程與破壞力多見於元史與元人筆記的敘述，並非同時人實測。1259年蒙哥汗在釣魚城軍中病死，蒙古軍退回四川，途中疫病與饑餓造成大量減員，數字不可考。1275年丁家洲之役，宋軍由賈似道抽調精兵十三萬，先鋒孫虎臣七萬屯銅陵縣北丁家洲，夏貴以二千五百艘戰船封鎖江面，賈似道自領後軍屯蕪湖魯港；元軍主帥伯顏兵力較少而主動出擊。1279年崖山之役，傳統記載宋軍戰船近千艘、軍十餘萬，元軍舟五千餘艘、兵二十萬，但雙方數字皆為事後估計，常有誇大之嫌；海面浮屍「蔽海塞」的說法同樣不宜當作實數。距離上，襄陽順漢水東下至鄂州約六百餘里，池州至丁家洲約百餘里。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are few, but a few sets can be used. Xiangyang and Fancheng were invested from 1267 until their fall in 1273, roughly six years in all. The garrison included several tens of thousands of militia; the stores of the city were said to cover about a year at first and only a few months late in the siege, and hunger drove the killing of cattle and horses for food and the boiling of banana bark, with stories of cannibalism also appearing in the historical texts, though the exact numbers cannot be verified. The Huihui pao was built under Aju, finished about 1271 and brought to Xiangyang after 1272; a single shot sent a stone ball of several hundred jin, and a direct hit brought down a wall tower. Its range and destructive effect rest on the narratives of the Yuanshi and the notes of Yuan literati rather than on any contemporary measurement. In 1259 Möngke Khan died of illness in the camp at Fishing Town, and the Mongol army withdrew into Sichuan, losing many men to disease and hunger on the way, in numbers that cannot be checked. At Dingjiazhou in 1275 Jia Sidao drew together 130,000 picked troops, the vanguard under Sun Huchen holding 70,000 at Dingjiazhou north of Tongling county, Xia Gui closing the river with 2,500 war boats, and Jia himself commanding the rear at Lukang near Wuhu; Bayan was outnumbered yet took the offensive. At Yamen in 1279 the traditional accounts give the Song close to a thousand war boats and more than 100,000 men against more than 5,000 Yuan boats and 200,000 men, but both sides' figures are later estimates and are often exaggerated; the same caution applies to the claim that the floating dead blocked the sea. In distance, it is about six hundred li down the Han from Xiangyang to Ezhou, and about a hundred odd li from Chizhou to Dingjiazhou.
cause: 金朝在1234年蔡州覆亡，宋蒙分據中原，本該是收兵罷戰的時機。宋廷卻在端平元年趁勢北伐，趙葵、全子才出師收復洛陽、開封，結果在洛陽折戟，退兵時又把沿邊堡寨與糧道丟了個乾淨，蒙古得以理直順勢要求割地賠款。賈似道的「國守家養」以銀折納歲幣、以錢收贖失地，名義是買回自己的州縣，實則每年解送的白銀成了蒙古軍費的補充，也讓沿邊將帥與豪強怨聲載道。蒙古內部1260至1264年的汗位之爭拖慢了南進，統一之後便傾國力而來：漢中與襄漢是南下江淮的門戶，控住漢水便能從上游放船直下荊州，繞開南宋苦心經營的蜀道天險；泉州造出的海船又能另走海路，攻擊廣州、福州、泉州，切斷沿海州縣的接濟。於是雙方都清楚，退一步便再無轉圜，戰爭因此拖成四十餘年的長期消耗。
causeEn: With Jin destroyed at Caizhou in 1234, Song and Mongols were left dividing the Central Plain, and that should have been the moment to stop fighting and go home. Instead the Song court struck north while the advantage was still theirs: Zhao Kui and Quan Zicai took the field to recover Luoyang and Kaifeng, broke at Luoyang, and in the retreat stripped the frontier stockades and the grain road bare, handing the Mongols a legitimate grievance and a reason to demand land and compensation. Jia Sidao's 'the state defends, the household sustains' paid the Mongol tribute in silver, converted it, and bought back lost territory with cash; in form the Song was buying back its own prefectures, in practice the silver sent each year supplemented the Mongols' war chest and left the frontier commanders and local magnates resentful. The struggle over the khanship between 1260 and 1264 slowed the southern advance, but once it was settled the Mongols came with the whole strength of the empire. Hanzhong and Jingxiang were the gateways to Jianghuai: to hold the Han River meant letting a fleet down from the upper reaches into Jingzhou, bypassing the difficult Sichuan road the Song had laboured to defend, while ships built at Quanzhou opened a second route by sea against Guangzhou, Fuzhou and Quanzhou themselves, cutting the coastal prefectures off from their supplies. Both sides understood that a single step back would be final, and the war settled into a consuming struggle lasting more than forty years.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超出一次改朝換代。崖山之後，江南政權消失，士人殉國與流亡成為一整代人的共同記憶，南人由王朝臣民變成被編入「南人」一等的征服對象，仕宦與科舉之路中斷，直到元英宗延祐二年才重開科舉，讀書人重回體制內的路徑，靠了許衡、姚樞一系以私淑古學維持。經濟重心則進一步南移，元廷倚重江南稅賦，先後開鑿膠萊河、會通河，1280年開始海運、1283年直抵大都，泉州、寧波與杭州的港市在元代更趨繁華。蒙古帶來的軍政體系與連帶的歐亞交通，使火藥、指南針與造船技術加速西傳，華人亦隨商旅與軍隊播遷到澎湖、琉球與南洋諸島。南宋覆亡同時意味著「中原正統」落在草原政權手上，中國歷史由分裂時代進入以蒙古為中心的帝國時代，這一轉向此後一直影響到明代。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reach far beyond a change of dynasty. After Yamen the southern regime disappeared, and the suicide and the exile of the scholar-official class became the shared memory of a whole generation; people of the south went from being subjects of a dynasty to a conquered population ranked as 'southern men' in the fourfold order, with the road of office and the examinations cut off until the imperial examination was restored in 1315 under Emperor Yizong, the learned men who stayed in the country preserving the classical learning that carried them back into service. The economic centre of gravity moved further south. The Yuan court relied on the taxes of Jiangnan, cut the Jiaolai and Huitong canals in turn, opened the maritime grain route in 1280 and ran it to Dadu by 1283, and the ports of Quanzhou, Ningbo and Hangzhou prospered still further under the Yuan. The military system the Mongols brought with them, and the Eurasian traffic that came with it, accelerated the westward spread of gunpowder, the compass and shipbuilding technique, while Chinese travelled with merchants and troops to Penghu, Ryukyu and the islands of the southern seas. The fall of the southern Song also meant that the claim to the true centre of China passed to a steppe dynasty, and Chinese history moved from an age of division into an imperial age centred on the Mongols, a turn that shaped the Ming that followed.
result: 結果是蒙古勝出，但勝得並不輕鬆。1273年樊城、襄陽相繼陷落，元軍據漢水上游取得東下之勢，1274年克鄂州，1275年丁家洲一戰擊潰賈似道十三萬精兵，賈似道罷相後在流放途中被殺，十五日內無為軍、太平州、和州、建康相繼歸元，臨安門戶洞開。1276年正月宋恭帝奉上傳國璽與降表，南宋朝廷在杭州投降，元軍入城時市井不驚。1278年文天祥在五真山兵敗被俘，囚於元營，寫下《過零丁洋》，1283年在大都就義。祥興二年二月，張世杰率宋軍列連環船於崖山，與張弘範所率元軍水師血戰，兵敗後張世杰中流矢死，宋將士多赴海，陸秀夫背著幼帝趙昺投海，後宮及官屬從死者甚眾，浮屍塞海。南宋至此滅亡，蒙古完成對中國全境的統一，1271年已建國號大元的政權自此以北制南，進入元朝前期的統治。歷時四十餘年、戰場自四川高原到廣南海面的宋元戰爭，終於以海上的絕望收場。
resultEn: The Mongols won, but not cheaply. Fancheng and Xiangyang fell in 1273, giving the Yuan army the upper Han and the run downstream with it; Ezhou was taken in 1274, and at Dingjiazhou in 1275 the 130,000 picked troops of Jia Sidao were broken, after which Jia was dismissed and killed on the road to exile, while within fifteen days Wuwei, Taiping, Hezhou and Jiankang surrendered in turn and the gates of Lin'an stood open. In the first month of 1276 the Gong emperor handed over the imperial seal and the surrender, the southern court gave itself up at Hangzhou, and the entry of the Yuan troops caused no alarm in the markets. In 1278 Wen Tianxiang was defeated at Wuzhen Mountain and taken prisoner; he wrote his Crossing of Lingding Ocean in captivity and was executed in Dadu in 1283. In the second month of the Xiangxing era, Zhang Shijie arrayed the Song fleet in linked ships at Yamen and fought a bloody engagement with the Yuan navy under Zhang Hongfan; beaten, Zhang Shijie was killed by an arrow in the fighting, many of the Song officers and men went into the sea, and Lu Xiufu carried the young emperor Zhao Bing on his back and threw himself into the water, the inner household and the officials following him in such numbers that the sea was clogged with the dead. The Southern Song was thereby extinguished and the Mongols completed their unification of the Chinese land, the regime that had proclaimed the title of Da Yuan in 1271 now governing from north to south and entering the first phase of the Yuan period. The Song-Yuan war, which had run for more than forty years from the highlands of Sichuan to the waters of the far south, ended at last in despair on the open sea.
